title: Geometric and topological rigidity of pinched submanifolds in Riemannian manifolds
summary: We study the rigidity of compact submanifolds of arbitrary codimension in Riemannian manifolds satisfying a pinching condition involving the norm of the second fundamental form and the mean curvature. In contrast to the corresponding earlier results, the pinching condition is not required to hold strictly. Allowing equality gives rise to richer and subtler geometric and topological phenomena.
